_about: The fix queue: art that was already placed in the world when the placement gate was seeded on 25 Oct 2026 (commit 14944c89), and only that. A new asset is never added here: it must pass independent review (scripts/review/gate.py, docs/review-agents.md). A queued asset may stay placed while it is redrawn, re-recorded and reviewed, and only while its entry holds: sha256 is the picture's current bytes (a queued picture that changes is refused until it is reviewed), the entry names when it was queued, why, what clears it and review_by, the date after which it is refused, and an asset an auditor failed carries the auditor's fix_list. Remove an entry when its asset passes (the gate prints an ADVISORY). 26 Oct: the scale gate added assets out of range (docs/reviews/2026-10-26-scale.md). 9 Nov (Claude A, the #439 triage): 48 Crossroads assets placed before the seed and never reviewed, which #421 or the front-gable roof build redraws, and 23 Crossroads props placed before the seed that failed the 8 Nov detail audit, each with its fix list; crossroads/ground renewed at its current bytes; woodland/ground removed (it passes). 9 Nov, after the woodland audit (#444, Claude A): the 13 woodland assets placed before the seed that failed it, each with its fix codes and fix_list (review_by 2026-11-30). The placed-before-seed rule stands. One dated exception, approved by Claude A on 2026-11-09 (the #439 triage): woodland/bramble_b, bush_b, bush_c, holly_b, lintel, standing_stone_broken, standing_stone_lean, standing_stone_runes, stone_top, hatch_closed and hatch_open (failed the 9 Nov audit, with their W- fix codes) and crossroads/square_puddles (cleared by #421's redraw), all review_by 2026-11-30: each was already on main and in its scene, and #439 is the first gate that would refuse it, so queuing it lets no new art in. Each such entry carries an "exception" field. Any further exception needs Matt or Claude A, by name, in the entry. 9 Nov, after the round-2 audit of #447 (docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 2; Claude A): the 17 Crossroads assets that passed are removed; the 14 that failed (13 props and crossroads/ground) are re-queued at their #447 bytes with the auditor's XR2 fix lists, each keeping its review_by.
